en.name: Ketchup, cocktail or chilli sauce
en.summary: These are the thick, tomato-and-vinegar table sauces. Unopened they keep about 1 year from purchase in the cupboard. After opening, refrigeration gives about 6 months — and the label's advice to refrigerate is about quality, not safety: a shelf-stable commercial bottle is safe at room temperature after opening.
en.pantry: An unopened bottle keeps about 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard. The part people get wrong is what happens next. Shelf-stable commercial ketchup, cocktail sauce and chilli sauce are safe when stored at room temperature after opening; quality, not safety, is the reason the labels suggest refrigerating them. Refrigeration simply ensures that commercial sauces and condiments stay fresh for a longer period of time. A bottle left in a warm cupboard darkens and loses its fresh tomato brightness rather than becoming hazardous.
en.fridge: The fridge is where an opened bottle holds its colour and flavour longest: about 6 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Wipe the neck and the inside of the cap after pouring — dried sauce in the thread is where mould gets a foothold, and it is also what causes the watery first squirt. Store the bottle cap-down if it is a squeeze bottle so you are not shaking it about at the table. Homemade tomato sauce or a bottle thinned with stock is a different product and belongs in the fridge from the start.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for these sauces and there is little reason to freeze one that keeps for months. Freezing separates a tomato sauce into a watery layer and a pulpy one, and whisking it back is imperfect. If you have made a large batch of a homemade cocktail sauce or chilli sauce, freezing portions is reasonable; for a commercial bottle, the cupboard and the fridge already cover it.
spoilage: Mould around the neck, the cap thread or on the surface of the sauce
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
A bottle that fizzes, hisses or squirts when opened after storage
Colour gone dark brown with a watery layer that will not shake back in
tips: Wipe the neck and the inside of the cap after every use.
Write the opening date on the label.
Keep bottles out of direct sunlight; light browns a red sauce quickly.
Never pour sauce that has been on a plate or brushed onto raw food back into the bottle.

faq.q: Does ketchup need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Not for safety — a shelf-stable commercial bottle is safe at room temperature after opening. Refrigeration keeps it fresher for longer, which is why the label suggests it.

faq.q: How long does ketchup last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 6 months after opening at 4 °C or below.

faq.q: How long does an unopened bottle keep?
faq.a: About 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard.

faq.q: Why has my ketchup gone dark?
faq.a: Tomato pigments oxidise with time, light and warmth. It is a quality change; mould, fizzing or a yeasty smell are the real warning signs.

zh.name: 番茄醬與雞尾酒醬
zh.summary: 這一類是濃稠的番茄加醋餐桌醬。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。開封後冷藏大約 6 個月——而瓶身建議冷藏，講的是品質而不是安全：常溫販售的市售瓶裝，開封後放室溫仍然是安全的。
zh.pantry: 未開封的瓶子放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。多數人搞錯的是接下來這件事。常溫販售的市售番茄醬、雞尾酒醬和美式辣番茄醬，開封後放室溫仍然安全；標籤建議冷藏的理由是品質而不是安全。冷藏只是讓市售醬料的新鮮度維持得更久。放在溫暖櫥櫃裡的瓶子會變深、失去新鮮番茄的明亮感，而不是變得有危險。
zh.fridge: 冷藏是讓開封後的醬維持顏色和風味最久的地方：4 °C 以下大約 6 個月。倒完要擦瓶口和瓶蓋內側——螺紋上乾掉的醬是發霉的起點，也是下次第一下擠出來是水的原因。擠壓瓶可以倒著放，這樣不必在餐桌上甩半天。自製番茄醬，或被高湯稀釋過的醬，是不同的產品，從一開始就該冷藏。
zh.freezer: 這類醬料沒有提供冷凍期限，而且一個冷藏就能放好幾個月的東西，也沒什麼冷凍的理由。冷凍會讓番茄醬分離成水層和果肉層，攪回去的效果也不完美。如果是自己做了一大批雞尾酒醬或辣番茄醬，分裝冷凍很合理；市售瓶裝則有櫥櫃和冰箱就夠了。
spoilage: 瓶口、瓶蓋螺紋或醬面長霉
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
放過一陣子後開瓶時冒氣、嘶聲或噴出
顏色轉成深褐，並分離出搖不回去的水層
tips: 每次用完都擦瓶口和瓶蓋內側。
避免陽光直射；光會讓紅醬很快變褐。
盤子上用過的、或刷過生食的醬，絕對不要倒回瓶子。

faq.q: 番茄醬開封後一定要冰嗎？
faq.a: 以安全來說不用——常溫販售的市售瓶裝開封後放室溫仍然安全。冷藏是為了維持新鮮更久，所以標籤才會建議。

faq.q: 番茄醬放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 開封後在 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 6 個月。

faq.q: 未開封的番茄醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。

faq.q: 番茄醬為什麼變深色了？
faq.a: 番茄色素會隨時間、光線和溫度氧化。那是品質變化；長霉、冒氣或酵母味才是真正的警訊。
